authority_lease.scope: Submit one diagnostic claim seed for public challenge; no canon claim, no standing above provisional, no self-witness.

build_plan.production_grade_definition: The claim is falsifiable per challenge_plan.falsification_routes; success/failure conditions are checkable against real outreach/shipping events, not self-report alone.

canon_conditions: Independent (non-fleet) witness quorum reviews the claim and it survives challenge.
At least one success_condition is verifiably met.
compost_conditions: Independent panel sustains the Varela steelman objection without a surviving distinguishing fact.
No outside contact event occurs within a reasonable window and no correction is filed.

falsification_routes: If a genuinely imperfect artifact from this estate reaches an external, non-operator recipient within the challenge window without the internal audit blocking it, the failure_condition side of this claim is falsified for that instance.
strongest_objections: Varela's own account: the technical work (autopoiesis) came first, independently, and the spiritual recognition arrived after. Read that way, 'stop building, go see through it' could be spiritual bypass dressed as insight rather than diagnosis.
The claim generalizes from one operator's one estate; it has not been checked against any other builder's history.

claim.decision_context: Whether the estate's internal, never-passable trust gate is best explained as rigor or as a structural consequence of an unexamined 'build the loop bigger' operating theory.
failure_conditions: The internal audit is invoked again, on this or the next artifact, to delay contact with anything outside the house.
claim.scope: dharma_swarm/foundations/PILLAR_07_HOFSTADTER.md's unresolved Hofstadter-vs-Jain tension, and its operational consequence for this estate's shipping pattern.
claim.statement: PILLAR_07_HOFSTADTER.md stages, without resolving, a real tension between Hofstadter's affirmative strange-loop thesis (build the self-referential pattern further, it becomes more real) and the Jain nischay reading (see through the same construction, don't perfect it). This claim holds that the unresolved tension is currently operating as an unexamined 'build it bigger' theory, and that this is a sufficient, mechanistic explanation for the estate's own self-diagnosed pattern: zero revenue ever recorded, zero completed outreach, and an internal audit gate reported as un-passable by construction. Full argument, including the steelman against this claim (Varela's own sequence: technical work first, recognition after) and a counter-model (Stafford Beer's twenty-year independent convergence of tantric practice and Team Syntegrity geometry, discovered rather than forced) is in the linked evidence artifact.
success_conditions: Within a bounded window, one honestly-imperfect artifact reaches an outside witness who is not the operator, without the internal audit blocking that contact first.

commons_return.minimum_return: The claim, its steelman, and its falsification routes stay public and challengeable in the repo regardless of outcome.
